name: Auto structure
description: Let the AI pick the structure from your notes and the conversation. Good default for most meetings.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Two to four bullets capturing what the meeting was about and what came out of it

sections.title: Discussion
sections.instruction: Organize the conversation by topic, one sub-heading per topic, with specific details under each (names, numbers, reasons, outcomes). Follow the order of the user's notes where they exist

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: Decisions that were actually made, each with the reason if one was given

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Every commitment or task, with its owner and due date when mentioned
